Program_Info.Program_Change_Info: PC Tweaker 1.20.0 adds an Audio section. See every sound device in use with its real format (Hz, bits, channels), effects, spatial sound and Equalizer APO status, plus findings that explain what is wrong: a Bluetooth headset stuck in call mode, a muted or very quiet microphone, Equalizer APO installed but not active. New fixes: "Don't lower my game during calls" (Windows lowers every other sound by 80% while a call app uses the mic) and "Fix Bluetooth volume control". Pro: keep HDMI audio or the sound chip awake so the start of a sound is not cut off, keep USB audio powered, and restart an audio device in one click. Check for crackles runs a 10-second driver latency trace against Microsoft's limits. Every change is recorded and can be restored with one click. The Scan gets an Audio category. 84 controls.
Program_Info.Program_System_Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64; internet for accounts, updates and supported online features.

English.Char_Desc_450: PC Tweaker combines Windows tuning, hardware monitoring and maintenance. Scan 2.0 runs 19 checks across eight categories; review the findings before making changes. Includes 46 Free and 36 Pro controls. Free tools need no account. Findings depend on Windows, hardware and drivers. The 1.19.0 interface preview uses clearly labeled sample data, not real-PC results.
English.Char_Desc_2000: PC Tweaker by Aurelio Avila helps you inspect Windows changes before applying them. Scan 2.0 runs 19 checks across performance, junk files, startup, privacy, registry, memory, hardware and latency. Review findings and choose individual fixes. The read-only hardware audit can report RAM speed, PCIe link and Resizable BAR findings when Windows exposes the data; it does not change firmware. Safe optimize lists proposed settings and requests a System Restore point. After supported optimization actions, Proof of change compares measurements and can report no measurable difference. The catalog includes 46 Free and 36 Pro controls. Free tools need no account. Pro adds advanced workflows, including Game Sessions, registry cleanup and Smart RAM booster. Registry discovery is free; Pro cleanup targets limited orphaned entries and saves a .reg backup. Registry cleaning is housekeeping, not a promised speed upgrade. Restore controls cover supported settings; restoring a setting does not recover deleted caches or replace a system backup. Windows 10/11 x64; features and findings vary by Windows, drivers and hardware. No universal FPS or performance gain is promised. Official Windows binaries are publisher-signed and timestamped; signing does not guarantee security or eliminate SmartScreen warnings. The linked 1.19.0 interface preview is captured from the official browser demo with a visible sample-data disclosure. Its readings are illustrative, not measurements from a real PC.
